There is nothing new about our knowledge of exhaling 'fat'. Time for a very short, simple science lesson:

When we eat, the carbon chains in our food are either used as energy immediately or stored as fat - which is just another carbon chain. When these carbon chains are 'burned' for energy, the carbon has to go somewhere. This is where breathing comes in - Oxygen (O2) is taken in, and carbon dioxide (CO2) is expelled. Notice that extra letter in the chemical, that 'C'? That is the carbon left over from our energy conversion - the carbon that came from either food or stored fat. This is why when you exercise you have to breathe more, and also why exercise causes weight loss - carbon from that stored fat is leaving our bodies. So yes, we breathe out our fat, and we've known it for a long time.
